title: Stray
description: Stray on Nintendo Switch 2 is a dedicated native version of BlueTwelve Studio’s cat adventure. Explore neon-lit streets and hidden districts, solve puzzles, evade threats, and work with B-12 to uncover the city’s past. Nintendo lists this version separately from the original Switch release, with an 8 GB estimated file size.
